context: LinkedIn apply-loop forensic repair under live owner observation plus resume-tailoring omission audit

context_transition.previous_context: TURN-70 live 15-cycle verification with funnel remediation
context_transition.trigger_for_switch: Owner moved execution to LinkedIn and reported silent zero-card runs, then watched applies fail live and demanded step-level diagnosis
context_transition.new_context: LinkedIn DOM forensics, modal-flow repair, validation handling, resume forensics

user_intent: Owner wants LinkedIn applications to actually complete while they monitor remotely: correct Easy Apply detection, full form filling (all control types, resume upload), numeric validation handling, step-progression diagnosis — plus proof that resume tailoring omits nothing
why_user_made_such_thinking: Owner watches the live browser and catches what logs hide: unselected dropdowns, skipped uploads, dead-end Review buttons, silently reordered resume content. Trusts eyes over log claims.
why_user_performed_this_way: Rapid terse corrections mid-run (interfering directly, e.g. driving-licence truth override) — treats the agent as a junior to supervise, not an oracle.
user_reaction_and_satisfaction: Corrective throughout: challenged wrong-button clicks, demanded error inspection, demanded full form filling. Satisfied only by live proof (watched modal open with pre-filled profile, watched first Easy Apply commit).
did_ai_actually_understand: Yes — each correction produced a same-session code fix verified live: DOM re-probe after every failed assumption, unit checks on regex logic, live cycles proving each repair.
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes — LinkedIn applies flowing (including first Easy Apply commit), numeric retry, control coverage, chatbot H1 removal, velocity governors, resume guardrail, docs updated, handover file written.
evolutionary_takeaways: 1) Silent skips are the worst failure mode — bare except+continue hid two total LinkedIn blackouts; every skip path must log or count. 2) Prove clicks with modal appearance, not click success. 3) Forensic diffs beat impressions: 63/63 bullets ended the omission debate instantly. 4) Owner corrections to learned truths are principal ground truth — apply immediately with backup.
